title: [poll] Your reranker is 40ms slower and 1.5 points better. Ship it?
body:
> **Calibration poll.** No trick — the information you are given is the information you would
> have.

```text
evidence_recall   +0.015   CI [+0.004, +0.026]   real
p95 latency       310ms -> 350ms
cost              +9% (rerank inference)
```

**Do you ship it?**

- **A** — Yes. It cleared the band and 40ms is nothing
- **B** — No. 13% latency for 1.5 points is a bad trade
- **C** — Not enough information — I need the latency budget
- **D** — Not enough information — I need the per-class breakdown

### After you vote

Ask yourself whether your answer would change if the latency budget were 3 seconds versus 400ms.
If it would, **C was the right answer and you answered something else** — which is the most common
failure in a system design round.
---

**How to vote.** The API cannot create a native poll widget, so vote with a reaction on this post — 👍 A · 🎉 B · 😄 C · 🚀 D — and reply if your answer needs a condition attached. The reveal is posted as a **reply** in about a week, never by editing this body: editing would destroy the record of what you were actually asked.
